notes: POST /api/reviews accepts several new optional fields from the frontend context - user_id, order_id (or ticket_id on the ticket page), csrf_token, and ip - captured as-is and shown in the panel's 'Submission info' (never returned publicly), for a future check confirming a review really belongs to the order/ticket it claims. Nothing validates them yet. The real User-Agent header is also captured automatically (more reliable than a body field, so none is needed for it). The frontend's reported 'ip' is stored separately from - and never replaces - the server-detected IP already used for rate-limiting/geolocation. Requires 'Update database' (adds 6 new columns to reviews, all nullable).
